20 mins daily of HIIT on the rowing machine can be a game changer : 1.	Burn calories in a fun fast way.   In 20 minutes, you can get a high-output session that hits hard without needing a long workout — working at 80-95% of your Max Effort it scales for wherever you are at. 2.	Build full-body fitness.   Rowing works your legs, glutes, core, back, and arms all at once, so you’re training more than just cardio. 3.	Boost heart and lung power.   HIIT pushes your aerobic engine, helping you get fitter, recover faster and feel less gassed in hard fast efforts. 4.	Improve endurance and work capacity.   The repeated intervals teach your body to handle intensity better.  Over time consistency builds and you can play with the variables of recovery.  The benefits carries over to other sport, training and everyday energy. 5.	Time-efficient and low-impact.   You get a brutal session in a short window and the rower is easier on the joints which has been a an absolute game changer. P.S so many wonderful messages about people starting to use the rowing machine more! I’ll be dropping some core workouts that I incorporate that have helped me develop an elite level of endurance and cardio and keep myself in shape.
